method: Twenty authorized low-resolution video frames were extracted with ffmpeg 8.1.2, reviewed at original sample resolution in two independent visual sessions, and hash-checked against the extraction manifest.
evidence_boundary: complete_for_sampled_claims means the sampled UI, reference asset, composition or timeline is directly visible. A still frame cannot prove motion, audio, temporal continuity, prompt causality, an operation succeeding, or model quality.
